# cdnpro Provider

Manage CDN Pro configuration (properties, certificates, edge hostnames and deployments) through the CDN Pro API. Every request is signed with the API user and key using the API's HMAC-SHA1 scheme; the key is never logged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cdnpro = {
      source = "HuberyChen1/cdnpro"
    }
  }
}

provider "cdnpro" {
  server   = "https://ngapi.cdnetworks.com" # or set CDNPRO_SERVER
  api_user = var.cdnpro_api_user            # or set CDNPRO_API_USER
  api_key  = var.cdnpro_api_key             # or set CDNPRO_API_KEY

  # Optional. Async operations are polled at a fixed interval until they finish.
  polling {
    validation_interval    = "10s"
    validation_timeout     = "10m"
    deployment_interval    = "20s"
    deployment_timeout     = "10m"
    edge_hostname_interval = "20s"
    edge_hostname_timeout  = "10m"
  }
}

variable "cdnpro_api_user" {
  type = string
}

variable "cdnpro_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key used to sign requests. Falls back to the `CDNPRO_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `api_user` (String) API user (login name). Falls back to the `CDNPRO_API_USER` environment variable.
- `polling` (Block, Optional) Overrides for the fixed-interval polling the provider does on asynchronous operations. Values are Go durations such as `15s` or `20m`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--polling))
- `server` (String) API server, for example `https://ngapi.cdnetworks.com`. Falls back to the `CDNPRO_SERVER` environment variable.

<a id="nestedblock--polling"></a>
### Nested Schema for `polling`

Optional:

- `deployment_interval` (String) Interval between deployment task status checks. Defaults to `20s`.
- `deployment_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait for a deployment task. Defaults to `10m0s`.
- `edge_hostname_interval` (String) Interval between edge hostname provisioning checks. Defaults to `20s`.
- `edge_hostname_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait for an edge hostname operation. Defaults to `10m0s`.
- `purge_interval` (String) Interval between purge/prefetch status checks. Defaults to `30s`.
- `purge_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait for a purge or prefetch. Defaults to `30m0s`.
- `validation_interval` (String) Interval between property validation status checks. Defaults to `10s`.
- `validation_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait for a property validation. Defaults to `10m0s`.
